runtime_prompt_en:
Create a photorealistic fantasy field-biologist documentary: an original adult fictional woman with visible appearance and dark wavy hair guided by Image 1. At a volcanic plateau observatory above steaming fumaroles, she stands beside a calibrated range pole and records two separate creatures in one wide frame. Use Image 1 only as visible-appearance guidance. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Open elevated wide 3:2 view: keep her face readable and both creatures spatially separated, uncropped, full-body; keep all subjects inside frame. She faces the creatures, not camera, actively measuring: she sights along the range pole while aiming her tablet and stylus toward them.

Left: one two-legged winged wyvern topology in side-elevated three-quarter view; both wings fully inside frame, opened in opposite planes as two separate silhouettes against empty sky; neither wing merges with torso or background clutter: one head neck torso and pelvis form one coherent creature body during landing; exactly two wings connect symmetrically near the shoulders during landing; exactly two weight-bearing hind legs descend from the pelvis onto basalt; the shoulder wings occupy the forelimb positions as the only front appendage pair on the chest; one long tail continues from the pelvis without branching through the landing arc.

Right: one grounded single-body multi-neck hydra broadside; expose at least three independently edged neck bases spaced across its single shoulder/back before each continues separately to its head: one torso pelvis and limb system anchors every neck on basalt; three or more complete neck paths remain visible from torso to head in clear silhouette; each neck has a distinct non-merged root on the same shoulder system across the broad back; each head retains a separate silhouette jaw and orientation against the dawn sky; feet body shadow and nearby objects preserve one coherent creature scale on the plateau. Directional cold dawn side light, contact shadows, and ash ground scale.

Avoid: cartoon style, over-processed retouching, unrealistic hands, illustration look, low resolution, broken facial features, excessive HDR, fake-looking background, distorted fingers
